newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PEN PICTURES OF GALATASARAY PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PEN PICTURES OF GALATASARAY PLAYERS.

text.p: Pen pictures of Galatasaray players most likely to play in the February 9 Turkish first division match against Fenerbahce.

Mehmet Sen, goalkeeper, age 22. Former understudy has yet to prove he is the answer to club's goalkeeping problem caused by recent departure of veteran Hayrettin Demirbas and U.S. 'keeper Brad Friedel. Let in four goals against Fenerbahce in first team debut last year.
Bulent Korkmaz, central defender 28. Strong tackler with an aggressive streak that often lands him in trouble. Spent all his professional career with Galatasaray.
Feti Okuroglu, defensive midfielder, age 25. Burly, hard tackler only recently settling into team under coach Fatih Terim.
Vedat Inceefe. left-back, age 23. Bought by Galatasaray from second division Karabukspor this season after a surprise call-up for the Turkish squad for Euro 96. Good with high balls and free-kicks.
Iulian Filipescu, right back, age 22. Romanian international Filipescu is a capable all-rounder at home in defence, midfield and even up front.
Suat Kaya. midfield, age 29. Diminutive hardworker whose ball winning abilities often make up for lack of consistency in passing.

Tugay Kerimoglu, central midfielder, age 26. Team captain brought up through club's ranks. Has good vision and often plugs the hole behind the central attackers. Vital link between midfield and attack.

Gheorghe Hagi, midfield playmaker, age 32. Inspirational force with the ability to turn a game on his own. The Romanian is by far the mosty experienced player in Turkish football and has become firm favourite with the fans since joining from Barcelona last July.
Ergun Pembe, midfielder, age 24. Occasional Turkish international. A team player rather than one possessing great skill, works hard in the centre of the pitch, but constantly outshone by Hagi.
Arif Erdem, midfielder or right winger, age 24. Fast, direct winger who links well with striker Hakan Sukur. Best known abroad for long-range goal against Manchester United in European Cup in 1993.

Hakan Sukur, striker, age 26. Tall, British-style centre-forward hitting the net regularly again after bad spell last year. Failed to live up to expectations as Turkey's greatest hope at Euro 96 and had disappointing spell at Italy's Torino.
